item.text:
**Assessment**
- **Mostly positive, with real implementation gaps.** 2024 evidence shows Jokowi’s government and Bank Indonesia handling inflation, fiscal space, and several crises with generally competent, data-driven policy. The main negatives are weak cyber preparedness, some revenue/fiscal fragility, and broader structural problems that were acknowledged but not fully fixed.

**Accepted Claims**
- [BI-Rate Increased 25bps to 6.25%: Strengthening Stability and Maintaining Growth from Impact of Global Spillovers](https://www.bi.go.id/en/publikasi/ruang-media/news-release/Pages/sp_268024.aspx) — Bank Indonesia — 2024-04-24 — BI raised rates pre-emptively to defend rupiah stability and keep inflation within target, which is strong evidence of competence and forward-looking crisis management. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`.
- [IMF Staff Completes 2024 Article IV Mission to Indonesia](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/14/pr24221-imf-staff-completes-2024-article-iv-mission-to-indonesia) — IMF — 2024-06-14 — IMF said growth remained strong, inflation was low and contained, and fiscal/monetary frameworks were prudent and shock-ready. That is direct positive evidence for competent macro management. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`.
- [Indonesia Economy Projected to Remain Resilient](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/24/indonesia-economy-projected-to-remain-resilient) — World Bank — 2024-06-24 — The Bank said Indonesia had low inflation, resilient growth, and macro policies that had built buffers through recent global shocks. This supports a strong competence reading. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`.
- [Macro Poverty Outlook for Indonesia: October 2024 Datasheet](https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099026110152411280) — World Bank — 2024-10-02 — Poverty fell from 17.5% to 15.8% in 2024 while growth held around 5%, showing the government navigated a soft external environment without a major macro breakdown. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`, `5B.8`.
- [Indonesia books lower-than-expected 2024 fiscal deficit](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indonesias-budget-deficit-in-2024-at-23-of-gdp-3796361) — Reuters — 2025-01-05 — Reuters reported a 2024 deficit of 2.29% of GDP, below the legal 3% ceiling and below the government’s earlier estimate. That is strong evidence for competent fiscal management, though the article notes higher debt issuance and a cancelled tax hike. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`.
- [Jokowi orders audit of Indonesia’s data centres after cyberattack](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3268495/jokowi-orders-audit-indonesias-data-centres-after-cyberattack) — Reuters via SCMP — 2024-06-28 — After the ransomware attack, Jokowi ordered a governance audit rather than denying the failure or escalating theatrically. This is a competent corrective response to a serious shock. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`.
- [President urges BPKP to audit National Data Center governance](https://en.antaranews.com/news/317175/president-urges-bpkp-to-audit-national-data-center-governance) — ANTARA News — 2024-06-28 — The government publicly acknowledged the cyber failure and moved to audit data-center governance, which supports an honesty-and-correction reading. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`.
- [Indonesia’s tax agency probes alleged personal data breach](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indonesias-tax-agency-probes-alleged-personal-data-breach-3622634) — Reuters — 2024-09-19 — The government responded to the alleged NPWP breach by investigating and urging mitigation, but the reporting also highlights a broader pattern of lax data protection. This cuts both ways: responsive, but exposed. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`.
- [Indonesia’s tax agency probes alleged personal data breach](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/4347351/djp-bantah-adanya-kebocoran-data-npwp) — ANTARA News — 2024-09-20 — Officials denied a direct leak in the tax system while still coordinating mitigation with Kominfo, BSSN, and police. That shows an attempt at honesty, but the denial also leaves some uncertainty about how fully the problem was understood. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`.
- [Indonesia’s dwindling middle class seen dimming economic outlook](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indonesias-dwindling-middle-class-seen-dimming-economic-outlook-3610865) — Reuters — 2024-09-11 — Reuters reported layoffs and weaker job opportunities squeezing the middle class, which indicates that macro stability did not translate into uniform household security. This is negative evidence on the quality of shock absorption for ordinary people. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.8`.
- [Indonesia has made remarkable progress...](https://www.worldbank.org/en/country/indonesia/publication/indonesia-growth-and-jobs-report-running-faster-for-longer-structural-transformation-productivity-and-good-jobs) — World Bank — 2024 — The report says unemployment fell over the long run, but also that too many workers remained in low-value work and structural constraints limited wage growth. This is mixed evidence: competent stabilization, but incomplete job-quality recovery. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`, `5B.8`.
- [Indonesia can keep budget deficit under 3% ceiling, World Bank says](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indonesia-can-keep-budget-deficit-under-3-ceiling-world-bank-says-3492963) — Reuters via Investing.com — 2024-06-23 — The World Bank said falling commodity prices and cost-of-living measures were pressuring the budget, but the deficit could remain within the legal ceiling. That supports competent but constrained crisis management. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`.
- [Indonesia president orders audit of data centres after cyberattack](https://tech.yahoo.com/business/articles/bulk-indonesia-data-hit-cyberattack-075758741.html) — Reuters — 2024-06-28 — Reuters reported that much of the affected data had not been backed up, exposing a serious preparedness failure. This is the clearest negative evidence against full competence in crisis readiness. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`.
- [Indonesia's tax agency probes alleged personal data breach](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indonesias-tax-agency-probes-alleged-personal-data-breach-3622634) — Reuters — 2024-09-19 — The alleged breach affecting millions, including Jokowi, points to continuing administrative vulnerability despite mitigation orders. This is negative evidence on resilience and implementation quality. IDs: `5B.9`, also `5B.6`.

**Search Gap**
- I did not find strong 2024 evidence of **sanctions management**, because Indonesia was not a sanctions-heavy case in 2024.
- Direct evidence on **unemployment policy** was thinner than on inflation, fiscal policy, and cyber crises; the best available signals are aggregate job and poverty statistics rather than specific labor-market interventions.
- I also did not find clear evidence of **dishonest blame-shifting** in macro policy; the negative case is mainly about **implementation fragility and preparedness gaps**, not systematic denial.
